title: The Mind-Blowing Machines that Stamp Millions of Metal Parts - Smarter Every Day 288
summary: Destin Sandlin tours a progressive metal stamping factory, showing machines that stamp millions of metal parts and the tooling behind them.
why: Recommended for factory-process fans and as part of a series on how US manufacturing is losing tooling capability.

quote.text: SmarterEveryDay has a whole series[1] on manufacturing that covers how the US is losing/lost the ability to create tooling.
